params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Kha'Zix}} gains ''Unseen Threat'' whenever the enemy loses {{tip|sight}} of him causing his next basic attack against an enemy Champion to deal bonus magic damage and slow.
params.blurb4: {{sbc|Unseen Threat:}} '''Kha'Zix's''' next basic attack against an enemy champion deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for a short time.
params.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Kha'Zix''' gains ''Unseen Threat'' whenever the enemy loses {{tip|sight}} of him or he activates ''{{ai|Void Assault|Kha'Zix}}''.

{{sbc|Unseen Threat:}} '''Kha'Zix''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} against an enemy champion to deal {{pplevel|22 to 141|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 50% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} and {{tip|slow}} them by 25% for 2 seconds.
params.notes:
* Any form of vision loss may trigger ''Unseen Threat'', such as {{ai|Curse of the Black Mist|Senna}}, {{tip|nearsight}} and {{ai|Brushmaker|Ivern}}.
* {{ai|Void Assault|Kha'Zix}} grants ''Unseen Threat'' even if '''Kha'Zix''' never becomes unseen (e.g. affected by {{tip|true sight}}).
** Other {{tip|stealth}} such as {{cai|E|Senna}} does not do this.
* Both the attack's damage and bonus spell damage are grouped under the same {{tip|cast instance}}.<!--used to say spell id, dunno what that is-->
** Because of this, a single ''Unseen Threat'' attack does '''not''' trigger two {{ri|Electrocute}} stacks.

params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kha'Zix''' slashes the target enemy, dealing {{as|physical damage}}, increased against {{as|Isolated|buzzword}} targets.

{{Effect at cast time end}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Evolved Bonus:}} ''Void Spike'' now fires three clusters in a cone, {{tip|slow|slowing}} and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} enemy champions hit for a short time.
params.blurb2: The {{tip|slow}} is more potent against {{as|Isolated|buzzword}} targets.
params.description: {{sbc|Evolved Bonus:}} ''Void Spike'' now fires three clusters in a cone, {{tip|slow|slows}} by 40% and {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} enemy champions hit for {{fd|2.25}} seconds. Multiple explosions do not deal additional damage against the same target nor provide '''Kha'Zix''' with extra healing.
params.description2: {{as|Isolated|buzzword}} targets hit by ''Evolved Spike Racks'' are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 60% instead.
params.angle: <!--{{tt|X{{degree}}|Right and left missiles at (X/2)° to their side, respectively}}-->
params.notes:
{{Effect at cast time end}}
* An enemy cannot be hit by more than one cluster at a time; the missiles will not collide with enemies that have already been hit.
* ''Evolved Spike Racks''' effect radius is centered around the location of the missile as it collides.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will not block the {{tip|sight|reveal}}.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Kha'Zix}} {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target location, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies upon landing.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kha'Zix''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target location, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies upon arrival.
params.description2: ''{{ai|Taste Their Fear|Kha'Zix}} can be cast during the dash.''
params.notes:
* ''Leap'' has no minimum dash range.
* '''Kha'Zix''' can use his [[summoner spells]] and [[active ability items|item actives]] while {{tip|dash|leaping}}.
'''Buffering Interactions'''
* {{ai|Taste Their Fear|Kha'Zix}} can be buffered to cast after the {{tip|dash|leap}} ends if it is cast while the target is out of range. There is no check for the target coming in range during the {{tip|dash|leap}}.
** If the target is still out of range after landing, there will be a {{fd|0.5}} second delay  before '''Kha'Zix''' starts moving towards the target compared to manually casting {{ai|Taste Their Fear|Kha'Zix}} after landing.
* {{ai|Void Spike|Kha'Zix}} & {{ai|Void Assault|Kha'Zix}} can be buffered to cast after the {{tip|dash|leap}} ends.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} Each rank in ''Void Assault'' allows '''Kha'Zix''' to evolve one of his abilities, granting it additional effects.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Kha'Zix}} gains {{ai|Unseen Threat|Kha'Zix}} and becomes {{tip|invisible}} and gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for a brief time. Upon breaking invisibility, ''Void Assault'' can be cast a second time at no additional cost.
params.description:
{{sbc|Passive:}} Each rank in ''Void Assault'' allows '''Kha'Zix''' to evolve one of his {{tip|abilities}}, granting it additional effects. Evolving an ability causes him to enter a 2-second [[cast time]].

'''''Kha'Zix''' cannot evolve while he is affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}} or a {{tip|lockout}} that disables abilities.''
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Kha'Zix''' becomes {{tip|invisible}} for {{ap|1.25}} seconds, during which he gains {{sti|ms|{{as|40% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
params.description3: After 2 seconds of leaving {{tip|invisibility}}, and for the next 12 seconds, ''Void Assault'' can be recast at no additional cost.
params.notes:
*Each cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* '''Kha'Zix''' receives the evolution even if he dies while in cast time.
* Every time ''Void Assault'' is ranked, a secondary menu will pop up for '''Kha'Zix''' to select an ability to evolve, this can only be done once per ability.
** The only way for '''Kha'Zix''' to evolve all of his abilities is to gain the fourth evolution point by being victorious in [[The Hunt is On!]] (by scoring a {{tip|takedown}} on {{ci|Rengar}}).
* Using a {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|breaks stealth}} at the end of the attack windup.{{bug|2}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Evolved Bonus:}} The {{tip|invisibility}} is extended, and ''Void Assault'' can be cast up to 3 times.
